pub fn manifest_with_runtime_build_dependency() -> &'static str {
    r#"[package]
name = \"my-app\"
version = \"0.1.0\"

[build-dependencies]
cc = \"1.0\"

[dependencies]
cc = \"1.0\"
serde = \"1.0\"
"#
}

pub fn build_dependency_is_used_at_runtime() -> bool {
    let manifest = manifest_with_runtime_build_dependency();
    manifest.contains("[build-dependencies]") && manifest.contains("[dependencies]\ncc =")
}
